claims.claim: Prestine UK direct PS4 slim console in smooth working condition.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show the console model/brand/region text; no power-on/boot test or condition close-ups are shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: No seals/opening/inside photos; witness only notes a controller and ports panel appearance.
No temperature/usage history or test footage shown.
Witness notes multiple ports visible, but no functional port testing is shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and an extra pad.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows one controller; no second controller is shown.

risks.risk: Unclear exact console model/variant (PS4 Slim vs other PlayStation-style unit) and region/UK version; wrong model/region affects compatibility and resale.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model/region label (serial/model sticker) and the console front/back branding visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/uncertain PlayStation-style console bundle with unknown model/region.

risks.risk: No proof it fully works (no power-on/boot, no game loading, no controller pairing test).
risks.proof: Short video clip: power on → boots to home screen → controller connects and works (buttons + analog movement).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults.

risks.risk: Controller condition issues (stick drift, worn buttons, charging/port problems) not shown by a single static photo.
risks.proof: Video clip showing analog sticks centered (no drift) and button presses responding; also show charging/USB connection working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller may need repair/replacement.

risks.risk: Port damage or intermittent faults (HDMI/USB/power) can’t be confirmed from port openings alone.
risks.proof: Video clip plugging HDMI + USB devices and showing stable output/recognition; wiggle test for loose ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports may be unreliable.

risks.risk: Storage capacity (HDD/SSD size) and whether it’s included are unknown; affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of system storage screen (Settings → Storage) or a screenshot/video showing capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common capacity assumption for the model.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (HDMI cable, power adapter, extra controller, headset) not confirmed.
risks.proof: Lay-out photo of everything included (power adapter, HDMI, cables, both controllers, receipt).
risks.if_unproven: Price as only the visible controller + minimal cables.

risks.risk: Account/lock status or region/account restrictions (e.g., console tied to an account) not shown.
risks.proof: Video clip showing Settings → Account Management and that it’s not locked/tied (or shows sign-out / primary console status).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model/serial/region sticker (front/back label) so we can confirm PS4 Slim and UK version.
Short power-on/boot video to the home screen, showing the console working.
Controller test video: pairing + button presses + analog stick movement with no drift.
Video showing HDMI output working and at least one USB port recognition (e.g., controller/USB device).
Photo/screenshot of Settings → Storage showing HDD/SSD capacity.
Photo of the full bundle contents laid out (confirm whether there are 2 controllers, and show HDMI + power adapter + any other accessories).
Photo of the UK receipt (or a clear scan) if it’s included.
response.reason: The witness confirms a PlayStation-style console/controller appearance, but key details needed to price confidently (exact model/region, working status, included accessories like the extra pad, and storage) are not verifiable from the report. Request the specific proof items before setting a price.
